blocks.body:
name = "acme/training-keys"
version = "1.0.0"
[roles.critic]
policy = "yes"

[training]
fork = "no"
max_concurrent = 0
learnable_band = [0.9, 0.1]
admit = 3
difficulty = 5
reward = "binary"

diagnostics.message: [training] reward "binary" is spelled "strict", the rubric's name for the all-or-nothing score: write reward = "strict"
[training] learnable_band is [low, high], two pass rates with 0 <= low < high <= 1
[training] fork is true (the default: a runtime may start episodes from a snapshot) or false (every episode is set up from scratch)
[training] max_concurrent is a whole number of episodes, at least 1
[training] admit is a table: { max_pass_rate, models, reasoning_effort }
[training] difficulty names an evidence file, such as "evidence/difficulty.json"
[roles.critic] policy is true for a trainable role, or false (the default)
